context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Dune presents this sentence as an epigraph from a fictional manual, making it sound like inherited wisdom from another age. That literary framing helps explain its portability, but the documented writer is Frank Herbert; the Michelangelo attribution has no supporting Renaissance source.
